explication: Malice is a Docker-based malware analysis framework intended to provide a self-hosted VirusTotal-style workflow. The main path accepts a sample through the CLI, records file metadata, stores the sample for container access, and dispatches enabled intelligence and MIME-selected plugins; results are stored in Elasticsearch. Separate CLI capabilities manage plugins, look up hashes, watch folders, and start the ELK-backed UI. The graph also shows Docker operations and the API surface. Some command implementations and API routes were not sampled, so those branches are documented or left without speculative internal links.
